question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH top10_states AS (
  SELECT state
  FROM alien_data
  GROUP BY state
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
state_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.state,
    AVG(ad.age) as avg_age,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as friendly_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as hostile_pct
  FROM alien_data ad
  JOIN top10_states t10 ON ad.state = t10.state
  GROUP BY ad.state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as result_count
FROM state_stats
WHERE friendly_pct > hostile_pct
  AND avg_age > 200

    ad.state,
    AVG(ad.age) as avg_age,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as friendly_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ad.aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as hostile_pct
  FROM alien_data ad
  JOIN top10_states t10 ON ad.state = t10.state
  GROUP BY ad.state
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as result_count
FROM state_stats
WHERE friendly_pct > hostile_pct
  AND avg_age > 200
